comments.body: Thanks for the thorough write-up and tests. #473 was fixed on main in d1bed015f (adaptive thinking with `output_config.effort` on adaptive-only models, `budget_tokens` kept for older ones, effort combined with structured output) and released in [v2.7.0](https://github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/releases/tag/v2.7.0), so I'm closing this as superseded. If 2.7.0 still misbehaves for a model you use, please open an issue with the request it sends.
